name: Taimashi Izumi 2
source:
One year has passed since she defeated the ogres, and Izumi has gone from being a college student to being an office lady. She has spent the last year in peace, but those peaceful days are not to continue. New monsters have declared war on her.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ036129.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
击败鬼族一年后，泉已从大学生成为上班族。过去一年，她生活平静，但这样的安宁无法持续。新的怪物向她宣战了。

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ036129.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
